```lean
theorem putnam_1964_b2
(S : Type*) [Fintype S] [Nonempty S]
(P : Finset (Set S))
(hPP : ∀ T ∈ P, ∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅)
(hPS : ¬∃ T : Set S, T ∉ P ∧ (∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅))
: (P.card = 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1)) := by
  have h_subset_or_compl : ∀ (A : Set S), A ∈ P ∨ Aᶜ ∈ P := by
    intro A
    by_cases hA : A ∈ P
    · exact Or.inl hA
    · right
      by_contra h
      push_neg at hPS
      obtain ⟨U, hU, hU'⟩ := hPS A hA
      obtain ⟨V, hV, hV'⟩ := hPS Aᶜ h
      have h₃ : U ∩ V = ∅ := by
        apply Set.Subset.eq_empty_of_subset_empty
        intro x hx
        have : x ∈ Aᶜ := by
          intro hxA
          have : x ∈ A ∩ U := ⟨hxA, hx.1⟩
          rw [hU'] at this
          exact this
        have : x ∈ A := by
          intro hxA
          have : x ∈ Aᶜ ∩ V := ⟨hxA, hx.2⟩
          rw [hV'] at this
          exact this
        contradiction
      have h₄ : U ∩ V ≠ ∅ := hPP U hU V hV
      contradiction

  have h_not_both : ∀ (A : Set S), A ∈ P → Aᶜ ∉ P := by
    intro A hA hAc
    have h₂ : A ∩ Aᶜ = ∅ := by ext x; simp
    have h₃ : A ∩ Aᶜ ≠ ∅ := hPP A hA Aᶜ hAc
    rw [h₂] at h₃
    contradiction

  classical
  let Q : Finset (Set S) := (Finset.univ : Finset (Set S)) \ P

  have h₁ : P.card = Q.card := by
    have h₂ : ∀ (A : Set S), A ∈ P → Aᶜ ∈ Q := by
      intro A hA
      simp only [Q, Finset.mem_sdiff, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
      exact h_not_both A hA
    have h₃ : ∀ (A : Set S), A ∈ Q → Aᶜ ∈ P := by
      intro A hA
      simp only [Q, Finset.mem_sdiff, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hA
      cases h_subset_or_compl A with
      | inl h => exact h
      | inr h => contradiction
    apply Finset.card_bij' (fun A _ => Aᶜ) (fun A _ => Aᶜ)
    <;> simp_all [Set.compl_compl]

  have h₂ : P.card + Q.card = 2 ^ Fintype.card S := by
    have h₃ : P.card + Q.card = (Finset.univ : Finset (Set S)).card := by
      rw [← Finset.card_sdiff (Finset.subset_univ P), Q]
    have h₄ : (Finset.univ : Finset (Set S)).card = 2 ^ Fintype.card S := by
      simp only [Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_set]
    rw [h₃, h₄]

  have h₄ : Fintype.card S ≥ 1 := by
    have h₆ : 0 < Fintype.card S := by positivity
    omega

  have h₈ : 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1) * 2 = 2 ^ Fintype.card S := by
    have h₉ : Fintype.card S - 1 + 1 = Fintype.card S := by omega
    calc
      2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1) * 2 = 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1) * 2 ^ 1 := by rfl
      _ = 2 ^ ((Fintype.card S - 1) + 1) := by rw [← pow_add]
      _ = 2 ^ Fintype.card S := by rw [h₉]

  omega
```
